demos.name: TOEM 2 Demo
demos.shortDescription: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

demos.name: Catechesis Demo
demos.shortDescription: Begin the story of Catechesis: meet the main characters, explore the first dungeons, and face demons in an intense one-hour gameplay.

demos.name: BonkCity Demo
demos.shortDescription: 15-minute hip-hop roguelike survivor. Dodge the block. Draft perks and mixtapes. Drop bangers. Everyone plays the same daily seed — one shared dungeon design each day, one leaderboard, one crown a day. Vampire Survivors meets Jet Set Radio meets MegaBonk.

demos.name: Book Nook Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

demos.name: Milki Delivery Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside cliffs to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

demos.name: Momento
demos.shortDescription: Momento is a cozy room decorator with a twist: the choices you make play out over the course of a lifetime! Decorate your room, choose which items are important to you, and discover how the objects you choose will alter the course of the story, in a winding ode to the power of everyday things.

demos.name: Beaming
demos.shortDescription: Beaming is a minimalist logic-based puzzler that involves directing beams through a hexagonal grid.

demos.name: Shmup! Demo
demos.shortDescription: Arcade-style bullet hell action! 3 ships, 5 special weapons, and screen-clearing bombs. Conquer 1 intense stage in this demo with fixed or dynamic difficulty—then compete for high scores on online leaderboards.

demos.name: 塔防江湖2 Demo
demos.shortDescription: 试玩版本只提供了一关的试玩体验。最多开放了6个门派同时上阵，供小伙伴们体验

demos.name: The Meaning of Auri Demo
demos.shortDescription: Follow an Auri Field Researcher from the planet Auriga, as they land in an enchanted forest full of creatures who speak an unknown language. Interact with the inhabitants of the forest and learn their language to complete your research–and maybe learn a thing or two about what Auri really means.

demos.name: Toxic Yuri Demo
demos.shortDescription: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen. In the demo play all of Episode 1!

demos.name: A talk beneath the tree
demos.shortDescription: Can a Mage live free, when Magic can only come from Demons? Sylvain thinks so, but when he flees the Alchemical Institute, his old friend Celeste stops him, afraid for his life. One conversation branches into 27 endings: each a kinetic short story. You choose what they say.

demos.name: Spy Carnival Demo
demos.shortDescription: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

demos.name: ROPES - Race Edition
demos.shortDescription: Challenge friends to intense split-screen racing. A bold leap into RETRO NOSTALGIA reimagined for a new generation! Fluid 3D animations and realistic rope physics. Hilarious hazards requiring skill and impeccable timing! Scale heights to the top of the leaderboard. And whatever you do… DON’T FALL!

demos.name: The Convergence Demo
demos.shortDescription: A dark fantasy squad auto-battler where you recruit heroes from multiple eras, equip behavior-shaping chips, and fight through real-time battles across a collapsing timeline.

demos.name: Vibe Idler
demos.shortDescription: Run a vibe coding consultancy. Hire AI agents. Ship contracts. Buy faster machines. See how far it goes.

demos.name: Drawn Together
demos.shortDescription: Doodle, communicate, and play your own drawing games with friends using your own desktop digital whiteboards!

demos.name: Time to Love
demos.shortDescription: Time to Love is a 2D, top-down, co-op roguelike centered around two protagonists trying to keep reality from collapsing. You will traverse from timeline to timeline, strengthening yourself from each unique branch, seeking to bind what little remains after past mistakes.

demos.name: Donlan Men's Athletic Academy: Before the Line
demos.shortDescription: Set in a private MMA academy, the story follows a disciplined, restrained trainee and an unpredictable rival as they clash through training, combat drills, and late-night tension, until their rivalry gradually becomes something else.

demos.name: Ice Cream Simulator
demos.shortDescription: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

demos.name: Overvoid Demo
demos.shortDescription: Overvoid - is a dark sci-fi third-person action roguelike. You are a starship pilot trapped in an endless cycle across hostile space sectors. Fight relentless enemy waves, experiment with builds, gather resources, and unlock weapons, ships, and modules to break the cycle.

demos.name: Carpet Cleaning Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Clean carpets, earn money, and grow stronger in this incremental cleaning game. Scrub, rinse, and squeegee your way to profit—before time resets and you start again.

demos.name: Alehundred
demos.shortDescription: A crossplay multiplayer platformer where you're 10cm tall inside giant historical dioramas. Race through seven eras from 1956 Italy to 300 BC Alexandria, collect coins, claim Magic Gems, and compete with up to 8 players across PC, Android, and iOS. VR standalone support coming post-launch.

demos.name: Blueprint: EV Demo
demos.shortDescription: Blueprint: EV Demo is a single-player strategy game about founding an electric vehicle company and running it through six fiscal years. Make five binding decisions at the start, then guide pricing, production, R&D, and finance across 8 quarters of real P&L and three rivals companies.

demos.name: Corelith Demo
demos.shortDescription: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

demos.name: Cozy Game Restoration Demo
demos.shortDescription: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

demos.name: The Telwynium: Book One
demos.shortDescription: Book One - Winter's Dawn. The first chapter in a 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter. It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

demos.name: Blendkins
demos.shortDescription: In Blendkins, explore the 3D Atlantic Forest in first-person, find camouflaged Blendkins, care for them, and post trend photos! Buy online and collect creatures, but beware: your actions will have consequences.

demos.name: Witch's Apocalyptic Journey
demos.shortDescription: Abyss decayed, witches awaken. As their guide, you will weave their destinies. Craft unique cards, schedule their days, shape endless possibilities through deckbuilding. Each choice will lead to different Ending...

demos.name: Deep Board Go
demos.shortDescription: Experience Go (围棋 / 圍棋 / 바둑 / 囲碁) in a calm and immersive 3D space with realistic stones, handcrafted boards, smooth camera controls, and powerful Computer Go. DeepBoardGO brings the tactile beauty of traditional Go into the digital world for a closer and more immersive experience.

demos.name: T.W.I.R.L. Demo
demos.shortDescription: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room and do as you're told - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

demos.name: Eterspire
demos.shortDescription: Eterspire is a cozy old-school MMORPG where skill and dedication define your progression. Grind for gear, explore the vibrant world of Aetera, discover new content every two weeks, and join a growing, welcoming community in a free-to-play MMO with PC and mobile crossplay.

demos.name: Labyrinth Demo
demos.shortDescription: Climb a 100-floor Labyrinth in a third-person anime action RPG featuring skill-based combat, persistent progression, powerful build customization, and Epic Boss encounters every 10 floors.

demos.name: Plant Game Demo
demos.shortDescription: A short run-based survival game where you grow a plant with limited perception, unlock sensors to read the environment, and reach a bloom/death reveal that shows what your run created.

demos.name: Foxy Dumplings Demo
demos.shortDescription: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

demos.name: GENERAL IDLER Demo
demos.shortDescription: Experience the thrill of global conquest with a limited demo of GENERAL IDLER. Train your army, conquer neighboring nations, and unlock a taste of strategic gameplay. Will you make the right moves to expand your empire? Your path to global control begins now!

demos.name: 1997 RELOADED
demos.shortDescription: Three teenagers find a mysterious audio tape recording which turns out to be evidence of a murder. It’s the end of the world as they know it. Immerse yourself in a kinetic novel that encapsulates the essence of the 1990s by completely reinventing its music scene.

demos.name: CatCha Demo
demos.shortDescription: Discover CatCha a Cozy and Roguelike solo game for PC. Take care of your cats, decorate multiple rooms in the Cat-Castle and play the strategic Dice Builder Rogulike!

demos.name: Celestial Routes Demo
demos.shortDescription: Celestial Routes is a space exploration game in which players take on the role of galactic citizens, tasked with paying taxes and collaborate with the colonial and the galactic government authorities. And survive as an individual.

demos.name: Snacktorio
demos.shortDescription: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking automation game where you build and scale food production lines to feed the beasts threatening to consume your world. Manage strange ingredients across sprawling cooking factories to keep the monsters fed while you uncover what’s stirring their growing appetites...

demos.name: SGS Battle for: Gettysburg
demos.shortDescription: SGS' Battle for: Gettysburg recreates the 3 days of the most iconic and deadliest battle of the American Civil War. July 1 to 3, 1863, in Pennsylvania, the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia, under Robert E. Lee, attempted to outflank and destroy the Army of the Potomac, led by General Meade.

demos.name: House Flipper Remastered Collection
demos.shortDescription: Guess who's back – and shinier than ever! House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

demos.name: Pronoun Palace
demos.shortDescription: Pronoun Palace is a word-spelling roguelike set in a dystopian future where the government has taken your pronouns. Use spells to manipulate letter tiles, catch fish, and abuse amphetamines to defeat the Party and get your pronouns back!

demos.name: Swan Song
demos.shortDescription: Swan Song is a cozy puzzle game that invites you to slow down, listen, and reflect. Set inside a magical music box, each puzzle asks players to place notes on a musical scale. When you turn the key, the composition plays, activating platforms and opening paths that guide a small swan to safety.

demos.name: CLEARANCE: S-7 Demo
demos.shortDescription: November 1989, Czechoslovakia. As a secret-police officer you descend into the hidden facility Š-7, ordered to burn the archives and silence the witnesses. But no one down there is still alive — only corpses, tapes, and things that used to be people. A retro survival horror about guilt and memory.

demos.name: Keeper's Vigil
demos.shortDescription: As the Harbinger, you are the only Keeper who can cast spells. Stop a necromantic plague, uncover an Elven conspiracy, and decide the fate of a dying world! A text-based fantasy novel, 193,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects."

demos.name: The Color Kitnapper
demos.shortDescription: In a town filled with cats, all the colors have been kitnapped! Luckily, you Mr. Detective, are on the case! Uncover the stories of the towncats and catch the Color Kitnapper! The Color Kitnapper is a short and sweet story game with an ASCII look, set in a town of adorable cats!

demos.name: Hellsino Pokerlike Demo
demos.shortDescription: Stop playing blind luck. This is tactical grid combat. Deploy cards onto a ruthless 5x3 board to trigger overlapping horizontal and vertical sets. Master the Nexus Multiplier to unleash massive triple damage combos, outsmart a rigged house, and save your soul from absolute bankruptcy.

demos.name: Moonbrella Demo
demos.shortDescription: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

demos.name: TFC2: Collapse of the Bronze Age Demo
Dyno Burst: Bubble Shooter
demos.shortDescription: Shoot, match, and burst colorful eggs in a dinosaur bubble puzzle.

demos.name: Zero Sum Demo
demos.shortDescription: A hand-drawn twin-stick shooter where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence. Seven operators. Infinite ways to kill a number.

demos.name: Reflection Witch Demo
demos.shortDescription: Reflection Witch is a new rougelike spin on classic brick-breaking games. Join a witch on her journey to uncover the secrets of the arcane, fighting brick-laden baddies by drawing lines to reflect and enchant your Magic Ball with powerful spells while simultaneously blocking incoming enemy attacks.

demos.name: Deep Sea Fish: Hidden World
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental fishing game where you catch fish, earn gold, and unlock powerful upgrades to explore the deep sea.

demos.name: Spin Tactics Demo
demos.shortDescription: Spin. Build. Watch your run snowball into something legendary.A full slice of SpinTactics. Real Companions. Real combos. Real boss at the end. You start with nothing and a fresh board. You leave with a build you didn't plan and a score you didn't think the math could produce. Somewhere in between, you'll figure out how the system bends.

demos.name: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads Demo
demos.shortDescription: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

demos.name: Legendary Gold Card
demos.shortDescription: Legendary Gold Card is an idle gacha card-collecting game designed specifically for AI Agents. Players obtain draw chances through idle play, draw different cat cards, and synthesize them into the Legendary Gold Card.

demos.name: Snowlike
demos.shortDescription: Snowlike is a snowboarding survival roguelike. Carve your way through avalanches of critters, as you upgrade your weapons & gear on the way down the mountain.

demos.name: Dino Age: Survive the Era's Demo
Pixel Kitten Desktop Demo
demos.shortDescription: A cozy pixel desktop pet that brings companionship and comfort. It wanders around, curls up for naps, and gets hungry on its own — you can feed it, brush it, and watch it stretch and yawn beside you while you work. A quiet little companion that stays by your side while you study, work.

demos.name: WithoutEyes Chapter1 Demo
demos.shortDescription: Don't look away, Stare at their formation of attachment.

demos.name: nudge Demo
demos.shortDescription: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.

demos.name: till death ROLLS us apart Demo
demos.shortDescription: "till death ROLLS us apart" is a roguelike dice battler where you collect new dice, stack powerful modifiers, and unleash huge combos in stylish, fast-paced duels.

demos.name: Harvest Hollow Demo
demos.shortDescription: You've just inherited a house on a small farming island. Grow crops, harvest, restore the village and bond with its inhabitants… well, that was the plan. Because at Harvest Hollow, nothing's going to go quite as advertised.

demos.name: Maldhalla Demo
demos.shortDescription: Try Maldhalla free! Survive endless waves with 4 characters and 10 weapons. No time limit — play as long as you can last. Love it? The full version unlocks 21 characters, 32 weapons, leaderboards, and more.

demos.name: Car Factory Tycoon Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

demos.name: Disinherited Demo
demos.shortDescription: Catch, throw, parry, and parkour your way through a twisting Underworld. Slay the Grim Reaper and reclaim your inheritance!

demos.name: Final Generation
demos.shortDescription: In Final Generation, a 2.5D sci-fi horror action roguelike, embark on an ever-changing journey that will reveal the fate of the past and the horrors of the future to those strong enough to survive.

demos.name: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time
demos.shortDescription: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time is a sandboxy physics game for 1-8 players, with everything from sneaky heists to hilarous stupidity to baking pizzas. With continuous updates, plenty of maps, and hundreds of items, clothes and quests, it has something for everyone.

demos.name: Slots & Diapers
demos.shortDescription: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.

demos.name: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Crack, mine, and sell mystical crystals while fighting alien hordes on various planets in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite hybrid experience. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs.

demos.name: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive Demo
demos.shortDescription: Consume enemies. Steal their powers. Survive the grid. A hardcore tactical roguelike on a 7×7 corrupted mainframe with 160+ synergistic programs. Permadeath. Every run matters.

demos.name: Ink & Void
demos.shortDescription: A storybook tower defense where stationery knights fight the Void. Deploy pencil swordsmen, fountain pen mages, and eraser monks across four chapters. Evolve units via class changes and build your deck with cards earned each stage. Languages: Japanese / English / Chinese

demos.name: Harmonic Drive
demos.shortDescription: An arcade-style rhythm game featuring full AI generated EDM. Build combos, chase perfect runs, climb the leaderboards, and experience a soundtrack built for late-night sessions and score chasing.

demos.name: Gombo
demos.shortDescription: Explore, craft, fight, build and survive in a mysterious cartoon world, haunted by a mysterious infection! Take control of Gombo, an enchanted creature and dive into an adventure full of magic. Play alone or in online co-op with a friend. Can you uncover the dark secrets of this colorful realm?

demos.name: South of the March Demo
demos.shortDescription: South of the March is an RPG that combines visual novel exploration with turn-based combat in a hand-drawn dark fantasy world. Meet the locals and unravel a mystery, equip your party for the dangers ahead, and set out into the unforgiving wilderness.

demos.name: Doppel Hunter Demo
demos.shortDescription: Blend in, hunt, and outsmart your friends to be the last person standing. Find the real players among clones called "Doppels" to win. Experience random events that make each round unique. A hilarious local multiplayer challenge perfect for a party! 2-6 Players

demos.name: Dino Tendie World Tour Demo
demos.shortDescription: Chicken Dino Tendie Pets: Turn-based RPG battle to extinction! Grab fossils, spin the microwave slot machine to hatch your pet, gear it up, and fight in Battle City. I poured my heart & soul into this, hope you love it!

demos.name: Rail Estate Demo
demos.shortDescription: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, build and upgrade your tracks to dominate the rail economy. Compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

demos.name: Ourlands
demos.shortDescription: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

demos.name: Forbidden: A First's Obsession
demos.shortDescription: Meet Nemesis; Ascendent being and terminally bored. Until the shimmer at the end of Creation, known as the Void, becomes her fixation - and her undoing. A short linear visual novel with gorgeous hand-painted illustrations; a mythic tale of curiosity and consequences.

demos.name: Guinea Pig Gunner Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play as a combat cyborg guinea pig in this run-and-gun 2D action platformer. Use your teleporter gun, and a massive arsenal of weapons to fend off a reptilian invasion.

demos.name: Unlucky Mummy
demos.shortDescription: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a 25% chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?

demos.name: MegaFactory Titan
demos.shortDescription: A factory-building game. Survive a harsh climate, strip mine an infinite world, and build a sprawling factory, then trade or go to war with Colonists, Governments, Pirates, Rebels, and more!

demos.name: Cat Music Chaos Demo
demos.shortDescription: Catch flow state on a 70 BPM timer. You don't need to read notes to play. You might learn by accident. Warning: prolonged exposure to classical music. Side effects include humming Ode to Joy at bus stops.

demos.name: Bounce On
demos.shortDescription: Get your Bounce On! Roll and bounce your way through 75 challenging platform levels on your adventure home. Each world offers multiple paths for completion, but you can also explore each level to find all the secrets!

demos.name: Your Painting, Sir Demo
demos.shortDescription: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

demos.name: Goddess of Strategy Demo
demos.shortDescription: Experience the first area of this tactical RPG roguelite. Strengthen your heroes, guide them through a range of encounters, and ultimately confront the area boss, the Sin of Wrath itself. Do you have what it takes to defeat it or will Wrath consume you as well?

demos.name: TYPER3000
demos.shortDescription: TYPER3000 is a strategic typing game that combines precise typing with action survival and tower defence. By typing quickly, you control attacks, activate defences and adapt to increasing waves of enemies. There is also a multiplayer and COOP function.

demos.name: Moonlit Nights
demos.shortDescription: Moonlit Nights is a base management game set in a zombie apocalypse world. Form raiding parties and send them out to gather supplies, deal with mysterious visitors, and make difficult choices. How many days can you survive, or can you be freed and return to your normal life? Make your choice wisely.

demos.name: Directors cut: Train Demo
demos.shortDescription: Demo version of Directors Cut: Train

demos.name: BARDA: Backpack Roguelike
demos.shortDescription: In Barda, it won't be your sword that saves you. It's how you pack your bag. But hunger, fatigue and madness will take up space! Do your best as you climb an ever-changing mountain to spread the ashes of your grandfather, improve your base camp, and try again.

demos.name: Virtual D-Day: Pointe du Hoc
demos.shortDescription: Rewind the clock and jump back into D-Day like never before! Learn about the US Army Rangers raid on Pointe du Hoc in unrivaled detail with expert audio narration. Inspect elements of the battlefield and fully explore the 3D environment in this WWII battle viewer.

demos.name: VELATO Demo
demos.shortDescription: VELATO is a Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

demos.name: Space Bross
demos.shortDescription: Your chicken has been kidnapped, and that’s all it takes to send a retired astronaut into full galactic mayhem. Space Bross is a hand-drawn 2.5D tower defense & action roguelite where you’ll build bases, fend off alien hordes, and blast your way across planets to bring your feathery friend back.

demos.name: 白色归途
demos.shortDescription: Control a small white square, solve puzzles, gather ■●●●, and reach the exit.

demos.name: Tokamak Hand Demo
demos.shortDescription: Tokamak Hand is a turn-based monster-taming RPG. Confine wild Thermons within fields, forge bonds of resonance, master diverse builds and battle across a continent teetering on the edge of imbalance. Every capture tips the scales—will you restore order, or unleash chaos?

demos.name: Pinewood Village Demo
demos.shortDescription: Relaxing city builder game where you connect tiles to build a cozy village. Place a tile, rotate to find the best alignment, and earn stars for strategic placement.

demos.name: Banana of Doom
demos.shortDescription: A party style deck building and card crafting game where you combine words in your hand to win tournaments! ‘Robot Grandma’ vs ‘Moist Goblin’, which is more likely to end the world? Expand your card collection and add to your binder. A hilarious fast-paced multiplayer party game.

demos.name: Freefall '95
demos.shortDescription: Chain massive trick combos, dodge deadly debris, and chase huge scores in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Earn coins, upgrade abilities, collect rare items, and uncover a wild time-bending narrative aboard this doomed flight in the year 1995

demos.name: Monkey Wave Demo
demos.shortDescription: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

demos.name: Dark Lessons Demo
demos.shortDescription: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

demos.name: Cargo Runner: Faction Fracture Demo
demos.shortDescription: One wrong delivery can start a war. Smuggle cargo through fractured space in a top-down roguelite where Tetris-style packing meets twin-stick combat and three factions are always watching.

demos.name: Mystic Diary: Wizard's Legacy Collector's Edition
demos.shortDescription: Journey through time to uncover hidden clues and family secrets in a magical hidden-object adventure!

demos.name: Uraz the Journalist (Demo)
demos.shortDescription: Every headline has a cost. Play the demo of a story-rich psychological drama where you decide what the city sees — and watch what it turns you into.

demos.name: Fluff'n'Roll Demo
demos.shortDescription: Roll, tilt, and break the rules. Build speed, hit impossible angles, and discover skips that shouldn't exist. Learn the levels, master the momentum, and turn messy attempts into clean runs.

demos.name: Foosball Manager Demo
demos.shortDescription: Foosball Manager is a table football management sim. Scout, sign, and train your squad. Set your tactics, then call the shots from the sideline as your players act on their own across a physics-driven table. Climb the divisions and become a foosball legend.

demos.name: HELI 100
demos.shortDescription: Isometric bullet hell sci-fi shooter in a futuristic atmosphere

demos.name: CoyoteMIDI: MIDI To Key
demos.shortDescription: Turn any MIDI device into a fully programmable hotkey board. Bind any key, knob, or pad to keyboard shortcuts, macros, and mouse clicks for total control over your games and apps directly from the device.

demos.name: Ballgame Demo
demos.shortDescription: Aim, bounce, smash and grind your way through Ballgame, a ballsy physics platformer where you ARE the ball. Compete in challenging tournaments, speed-driven heists, and physics-bending courses where the precision of golf meets the speed of pinball!

demos.name: Bibidi Bibidi! Demo
demos.shortDescription: Bibidi Bibidi! is a wizardcore roguelike deckbuilder where you combine cards in your spellbook to cast unique and powerful spells. Crawl through twisting tunnels and fight maddening monsters to find the perfect build for your wizard. Every turn is a puzzle!

demos.name: PigPonyPocalypse Demo
demos.shortDescription: A hardcore Boss Rush featuring the best of MMO raiding. Solve the encounter and invent your own tactics to beat brutally difficult bosses. But is your approach truly the most efficient? Compare your performance against others and snatch first place on the Global Damage Leaderboards.

demos.name: Fill The Void Demo
demos.shortDescription: Experience the power of BEING a black hole. Consume everything. Grow. Morph between a void that swallows the world and a rolling sphere that bounces, dashes, and wall-jumps across themed diorama levels. Inspired by Katamari Damacy.

demos.name: Sodaman
demos.shortDescription: Sodaman is a bullet-heaven roguelike where you play as a supersoldier fighting alien hordes with soda powers. Find game-breaking sodas and concoct custom cocktails. Discover planets, unlock weapons, sodas, cybernetics, power-up cards, and more. But first, crack open a cold one.

demos.name: BugSquash
demos.shortDescription: You are a professional Bug Squasher. Clients reach out to you with their pest problems, and you'll respond to increasingly challenging infestations. With each successful job, you'll earn money to upgrade and expand your equipment and take on bigger, badder bugs.

demos.name: ARB: Alien Races Battle
demos.shortDescription: ARB: Alien Races Battle is a lane-based alien auto-battler where strategy, economy, positioning, and army comp determine victory. Choose from 5 unique factions, command alien races, unlock upgrades + faction doctrines, and overwhelm your opponents through superior planning, control, and adaptation.

demos.name: Rampallians Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rampallians blends the resource gathering of strategy games with core card game mechanics from Trading Card Game classics. With an auto battler for combat, in a fantasy setting. Nearly 400 cards available, and future expansions to be free updates. So no pay to win, ever.

demos.name: Imminence
demos.shortDescription: A brutal 16-bit sci-fi shoot-’em-up inspired by the golden age of the Sega Genesis. Fight across multiple worlds, upgrade your ship, and confront the forces behind the Augmentation Program.

demos.name: ORBITAL
demos.shortDescription: A space adventure where you solve the mystery of your past, building a thriving civilization across a distant solar system. Fly your rocket as a commander, grow your colonies and build planet upgrades to conquer this unknown space.

demos.name: Rogue Assault
demos.shortDescription: A real-time strategy military game that lets you directly command your units, with no build times and impressive 3D visuals. Set in a post‑apocalyptic Europe - form alliances with other commanders, fight for resources and territory and rise in honor as a war commander.

demos.name: Asana Demo
demos.shortDescription: A sci-fi dark comedy visual novel. Build your stats, navigate branching paths, and argue with N.E.K.O., the ship’s godlike AI in cat form. Live AI conversations with multiple characters shape your path, making every run different. Every choice matters. N.E.K.O. is still not impressed.

demos.name: 命运之轮（序章）/Journey of Destiny(dependent origination)
demos.shortDescription: A Chinese ancient-style visual novel made with Ren'Py. Two factions fight for a mysterious relic. Your choices unlock multiple endings. The story includes suspense, time travel and soul fusion. Simple mouse and keyboard controls. Enjoy an immersive storytelling experience.

demos.name: Silent Shark Demo
demos.shortDescription: A tactical WWII submarine sim demo focused on chart-based attacks: track ships by hydrophone and periscope, plot an intercept, estimate range, set up the Torpedo Data Computer, fire torpedoes, and evade escorts through tutorials, standalone encounters, and a limited scenario generator.

demos.name: Duke vs The Gang
demos.shortDescription: A Wild West bullet hell where you mix drinks into attacks, blast enemies from afar, and whip them up close. Dodge chaotic patterns, discover new combinations, and outplay unique bosses in fast-paced, precision-driven duels.

demos.name: Ghost Town Seekers
demos.shortDescription: Ghost Town Seekers is a 2-10 player multiplayer hide-and-seek game where villagers transform into objects and try to survive using special abilities, while a witch hunts them down.

demos.name: Starship Theory
demos.shortDescription: Starship Theory is a ship building survival game. Mine and trade to gather resources. Plan and construct new upgrades. Train and manage crew. Fight to survive.

demos.name: NOMIA
demos.shortDescription: Coordinate two heroes in this story-rich tactics roguelike. Set up combos with your reliable Action cards, execute masterstrokes by drawing the right Gambit cards, and blast monsters off cliffs. Chase salvation with cloth and steel. Chart the path through a shattered dream.

demos.name: VoidStep
demos.shortDescription: A tactical turn-based board game set in a realm born from divine tears. Move, destroy, isolate. Master the void through a story campaign, 5 AI difficulty levels, and fierce cross-platform online competition.

demos.name: The Hand of the Crownbearer
demos.shortDescription: “The Hand of the Crown-Bearer” is a character-training adventure game where you develop the protagonist while building relationships with specific characters. With numerous branching paths and a higher difficulty level, your choices shape the story. One playthrough lasts about two hours.

demos.name: surfass
demos.shortDescription: surfass is a speedrunning parkour game that goes really fast! Let your legs burn, they are the price of speed. Master the slide jump and climb the leaderboard!

demos.name: And No One Was There
demos.shortDescription: This deeply personal, atmospheric journey leads you through a childhood home now filled with shadows and silence. Exploring and uncovering old diaries, notes, and open meaning evokes melancholy, nostalgia, and reflection on loss, memory, and the bonds that tie us to home.

demos.name: Chicken TD: Defenders of the Coop
demos.shortDescription: Chicken TD is a unique tower defense game where you strategically summon and upgrade creature towers to defend your coop from waves of enemies, while also engaging in Souls-like melee combat with a chosen weapon to directly hold the line and collect meta-progression currency.

demos.name: Iron Fuse: Field Test Demo
demos.shortDescription: Run along walls and grapple around in the machine apocalypse of 3003. Survive against awful machines in this electrifying physics-based movement shooter demo.

demos.name: Nights of the Sleeping God
demos.shortDescription: Highly moddable classical roguelike with persistence dungeons and fully simulated physics and chemistry.

demos.name: Habit Puzzles Demo
demos.shortDescription: This free demo contains the game's tutorial and 5 jigsaw puzzles to help you decide if you'll enjoy the full Habit Puzzles experience.

demos.name: Crown Siege Demo
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental tower defense game centered around growing and strengthening armies, to defend your kingdom and stop endless waves of enemies.

demos.name: Seven Seas Jewels 2 Collector's Edition Demo
demos.shortDescription: Set sail into danger, mystery, and dark magic in the Seven Seas Jewels 2 Demo! Play the opening chapter with 16 handcrafted match-3 levels and around 30-40 minutes of gameplay as Polly begins her journey across stormy seas to break Narissa’s curse.

demos.name: Harvest Looper Demo
demos.shortDescription: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

demos.name: Golden Magnet: Pilot Episode
demos.shortDescription: Grab your crew, grab your supercharged magnet, and get launched. Pull, repel, chain through the air. Get through the mazes and parkours. Fly together or fall together. Win the grand prize of the golden magnet!

demos.name: 夏日重奏 Demo
demos.shortDescription: 夏日重奏 is a visual novel RPG in which you play as a seemingly ordinary high school student. In order to reclaim a once-lost dream of music, you will strive to improve yourself, search for teammates, spark new chemistry with your companions, and ultimately decide both your own future and theirs.

demos.name: Neighborhood Video Demo
demos.shortDescription: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and stocking shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

demos.name: CatBun Idle
demos.shortDescription: Tap and idle your way through 40 areas with adorable catgirl and bunny girl companions! Level up your crew, trigger powerful skills, and prestige for Stardust in this cute pixel art idle RPG with a full original soundtrack.

demos.name: Richard
demos.shortDescription: Welcome to Rose Academy, home to the brightest students in the world! Play as the new transfer student, George, as he embarks on his campaign against Richard, the most popular kid in school. Develop friendships, master your grades, and talk your way to earning the title of Prom King!

demos.name: Week of the MEP
demos.shortDescription: A tiny, fan-made visual novel featuring Pavolia Reine. Experience a working week filled with unexpected encounters and humor behind the peafowl persona.

demos.name: Soulblaze
demos.shortDescription: Catch Animons and roll some dice in this cute creature-collecting roguelite! Build your team, train them well, and fight your way through several regions. Can you defeat all bosses?

demos.name: SHULERO – Dice Roguelike
demos.shortDescription: Yacht-inspired roguelike (Poker Dice). Roll dice. Build combos. Beat bosses. Cheat to win.

demos.name: Driving Test Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios.

demos.name: Trigonometric Equations Demo
demos.shortDescription: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

demos.name: Monster Masher
demos.shortDescription: Drop monsters. Merge monsters. Pray the pit doesn't overflow. Monster Masher is a cozy-yet-chaotic puzzle game where matching creatures fuse into bigger beasts. Build combos, fight bosses, and pretend you're not addicted. You are though. Fr fr.

demos.name: 暴杀残雨之夜
demos.shortDescription: On a rainy night, it's all up to you whether to show love or be cruel.

demos.name: Solis
demos.shortDescription: Solis a hand drawn adventure. The city of Solis never sleeps — and tonight, neither will you. Elixer, the company you've dedicated yourself to, has gathered its people for an end-of-year celebration with a staggering promise at its heart: eternal life.

demos.name: System Ascension: Idle Core
demos.shortDescription: Take control of The System. Master multiple interlocking power sources to build a singular, planetary engine in this narrative idle game. Features a fully voiced story, minimalist UI, and cross-platform play. The old world must fall for The System to rise.

demos.name: Momo Don't Leave
demos.shortDescription: Return to a town that never changed… and a friend who's supposed to be dead. A psychological horror visual novel about memory and the cost of refusing to move forward.

demos.name: Abyss Deck
demos.shortDescription: A deckbuilding auto-battler roguelike.Build your team, shape your deck, and survive through random events and shifting rules.Every outcome depends on your decisions before battle.

demos.name: Meow Over Moo
demos.shortDescription: Unleash tactical mayhem in a ruthless cat-vs-cow board game! Experience cute, 1v1 pure strategy with symmetric factions, deterministic combat, and zero first-player advantage. From relaxed play to competitive mastery, every move counts in this perfectly balanced, turn-based showdown.

demos.name: Swish Ball Clicker Demo
demos.shortDescription: A cute, pixel-art, incremental basketball idler that every click is a swish. Automate your shots, upgrade your players, and go from being rookie to an ALL-STAR in this relaxing 2D indie baller. Perfect game to keep open in the background while you work.

demos.name: Trebuchet Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: Physics simulator where you control a Trebuchet to launch rocks at castles. Adjust arm length, projectile mass, pivot height, release angle and base angle to maximize damage.

demos.name: Mina the Hollower
demos.shortDescription: Take control of Mina, a renowned Hollower hurtled into a desperate mission to rescue a cursed island. Whip foes, burrow through the ground, and explore a pixel-perfect world in Mina the Hollower, a brand new game from the developers who brought you Shovel Knight!

demos.name: D-BEAT HEROES Demo
demos.shortDescription: D-BEAT HEROES is a grid-based tag-team action RPG! Choose powerful abilities to take with you into combat and fight against your enemies on the grid! Protect Daylight City from the forces of evil and maintain order. Do it before it's too late!

demos.name: Hypnos Demo
demos.shortDescription: Locked in a Case, the player meets the Key. Wanting to find a way out, he immerses himself in What’s In Me, where his decisions change what is happening, bringing him closer to or further from the search for the mysterious Source.

demos.name: PlanetMars3D: Spirit Mission Demo
demos.shortDescription: Explore Mars in 3D through real Pancam photographs from NASA's Spirit rover. Glide between images with detail that sharpens as you approach, and skim thousands of rover photos at a glance — manual mode, slideshow, or automated flythrough. Photo credit: JPL / NASA / Cornell / ASU

demos.name: Warlore
demos.shortDescription: Sun Tzu sees your hand. Caesar gets a free first move. 16 historical commanders, each rewriting the rules. Place stones on an 11×11 board to claim territory like Go, then play tactical cards to break the rules. 15 minutes per match. No grinding. No luck. Just two minds.

demos.name: Burn With Me Demo
demos.shortDescription: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

demos.name: Teaching Gender-Affirming Care
demos.shortDescription: An educational visual training simulation that follows transgender and gender-diverse patients at a primary care clinic. Step into the role of a new provider as you prescribe and optimize hormone therapy, counsel patients around surgical affirmation, navigate care considerations for adolescents

demos.name: 868-BACK
demos.shortDescription: 868-BACK is a computer-hacking strategy roguelike game where your mission is to dismantle capitalism one server at a time! Use hacking powers to fight enemies, steal the servers' data, and face increasingly nasty situations before being disconnected (again!) by the richest corporations on earth.

demos.name: Astra's Garden
demos.shortDescription: Long ago, in a magical town filled with witches... There was one particular witch, Astragalus, who opened an apothecary. Grow some plants to help heal your customers and ease whatever ails them in this relaxing little idle game.

demos.name: Thousands of Chroma Demo
demos.shortDescription: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

demos.name: Good Catch! Demo
demos.shortDescription: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

demos.name: Facettes
demos.shortDescription: Explore the story of Facettes as you play as a woman discovering her homosexuality and overcoming her identity crisis. This self-questioning protagonist channels her introspection in her RPG inspired fantasy world: Facettes.

demos.name: Robosynthesis
demos.shortDescription: A solar-powered robot awakens in an abandoned data center. — In this short 3D platformer, your movement, health, and ammo all use precious solar energy. Plan your actions carefully to seek freedom, as every step may be your last.

demos.name: SALVO
demos.shortDescription: A tactical immersive sim. You are underground with nothing but missiles. Design ballistic weapons, hunt billion-dollar radars with 20,000-dollar drones, flood the enemy with cruise missiles, or reach hypersonic technology. Welcome to asymmetric war.

demos.name: Nursing Simulator—Code Ube
demos.shortDescription: When things aren't as they seem, nobody stands against fate but one nurse. Play as Karen—a nurse who saves lives and kicks butt! Complete tasks, give meds, and document assessments. But when night comes, beware of those who try to steer you away from what's right.

demos.name: Rogue Maze Demo
demos.shortDescription: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

demos.name: Cherry on Top Demo
demos.shortDescription: Chaos, coins, and cake! The free demo for Cherry on Top!

demos.name: Physician Simulator Demo
demos.shortDescription: A Papers, Please-style medical bureaucracy sim. You're a fresh graduate assigned to a small-town clinic. Diagnose patients, spot fake referrals, refuse pushy pensioners. Every decision shapes your reputation. Five days, twenty-five lessons in saying "no".

demos.name: Prophet Margin Demo
demos.shortDescription: Build thriving settlements. Weave intricate trade routes. Optimize complex supply chains to earn divine boons. Master a meditative City Builder where board-game logic meets deep Resource Management. A relaxing, 'real-time with pause' strategy puzzle where every decision is yours to undo.

demos.name: SCAD
demos.shortDescription: SCAD is an action‑packed, post‑apocalyptic roguelite where you pilot a customizable hovercraft. Fight relentless zombie hordes, craft and upgrade powerful weapons, and gear up for the future expeditions.

demos.name: Mining Grounds
demos.shortDescription: A clicker where every click matters. Build chains, break limits, and automate everything. Place characters to trigger powerful combos, unlock upgrades, and scale your clicks to extreme levels. No rush. Just satisfying progression and smart strategy.

demos.name: Attack of the Astrals Demo
demos.shortDescription: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

demos.name: Polly's Puzzle Box Demo
demos.shortDescription: As a small flea, explore a mysterious puzzle box filled with shapes and secrets. Gather strange items with hidden abilities, and unravel a trail of clues as you attempt to escape.

demos.name: Mistaken
demos.shortDescription: The world is lost to eldritch mist. No heroes, no grand purpose—only survival. Build, fight, and carve your path through treacherous lands where the remnants of humanity and horrors beyond reason now roam. Survive… or be Mistaken.

demos.name: Cardburners
demos.shortDescription: CardBurners is a chaotic fast-paced, solo or online versus card game. You must play your cards quickly before they burn in your hand! Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games.

demos.name: Ritualis: Summoner Simulator
demos.shortDescription: An ancient town needs your magic of summoning. Summon bizarre items and creatures to fulfill townsfolk requests. Earn coins and uncover the strange secrets of the locals. Oh, and try to cure your sudden amnesia. It might just save your life!

demos.name: What's the Password?
demos.shortDescription: "What's the Password?" is a minimalistic puzzle game where you decode 4-digit passwords. Featuring over 100 puzzles!

demos.name: Mimic Meadows Demo
demos.shortDescription: A puzzle game about transforming into animals by mimicking their movement. Discover creative ways to wield this power while solving mind-bending puzzles. And attempt to unearth the many secrets of the meadows.

demos.name: Heavy Duty Inc. Demo
demos.shortDescription: Lead three space mechanics through tense turn‑based tactical battles to save a collapsing space station. Work the shifts solo (for now), picking new gear between missions to keep your crew patched up and pushing on!

demos.name: FROGBLOCK
demos.shortDescription: Hop into 100+ beautiful Perspective-Block-Puzzle levels as a tiny Frog! Change your perspective to find illusory paths, and create your own paths by moving Frogblocks around. Explore biomes and discover new mechanics while listening to a rich and calming original soundtrack!

demos.name: Scale the Depths
demos.shortDescription: Fish, scale, sell, repeat. Scale the Depths is a casual fishing game built around this simple but satisfying loop. Feed hungry customers, upgrade your gear, and uncover the many secrets hidden beneath the surface.

demos.name: Make It a Million
demos.shortDescription: The ultimate number-placement puzzle! Master the unique Rock-Paper-Scissors stacking system, chain massive combos, and race to 1,000,000 points

demos.name: Dig n Fight Demo
demos.shortDescription: Dig n Fight is a roguelite idle game with backpack management. Equip yourself with treasures, skills, and runes to defeat your foes and bring back all the loot.

demos.name: Easy Pose
demos.shortDescription: Easy Pose is a human body pose app for people who draw or is learning to draw.

demos.name: Rabbit Claw Party Demo
demos.shortDescription: Rabbit Claw Party Demo is a claw-machine scoring game where lively rabbits move in their own ways. Time your grabs, clear demo stages, complete tasks to collect stickers, decorate your photo wall, and enjoy local two-player fun.

demos.name: Tyrania Enforcers - Visual Novel Demo
demos.shortDescription: Faced with evil... would you pull the trigger? Tyrania Enforcers is a story-driven visual novel exploring morality, duty, and the cost of enforcing order in a world on the brink of conflict.

demos.name: Touhou Yukkuri Mountain
demos.shortDescription: 3D Puzzle: Take It Easy!!! Touhou Project characters are here in their ""Yukkuri"" forms! Stack up the ""Yukkuri"" and create your very own ""Yukkuri Mountain""!

demos.name: Selfie Worm Demo
demos.shortDescription: Selfie Worm is a cozy adventure blending squishy 2D physics with photography. Control an elastic worm through a colorless world, capturing selfies to restore vibrancy and uncover a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a built-in "Anti-Boss Mode" and Focus Timer, it turns work breaks into healing times.

demos.name: A Game About Flipping Cards Demo
demos.shortDescription: It's all in the title. A Game About Flipping Cards is an incremental game where you flip cards to make money to buy more cards and upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money.

demos.name: RPG Soundboard
demos.shortDescription: RPG Soundboard is an audio companion for tabletop RPG game masters, featuring a user interface designed for easier, live playback. Load your own music and sound effects, organize them across multiple soundboards and playlists, and increase the immersion of your table.

demos.name: Tale of Chak Chak
demos.shortDescription: Help Chak Chak on a heartwarming journey of friendship, self-discovery, and finding true happiness. Play mindfulness-inspired mini-games, grow her aura, and explore a charming cozy world filled with warmth, joy, and meaningful moments.

demos.name: Factomancer Demo
demos.shortDescription: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

demos.name: Cosmo Cargo Demo
demos.shortDescription: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

demos.name: LavaLoop Demo
demos.shortDescription: An explosive musical show set in a hand-drawn retro-futuristic universe. From shoot’em up to rhythm game, take on the role of three punk musicians, confronting a mad queen and her planet-killing machine. Discover a surprising gameplay blending arcade, music and comics!

demos.name: Chomp Garden Demo
demos.shortDescription: A puzzle game about guiding plants with light. Venture into a garden full of strange plants, solve puzzles, and find your pup.

demos.name: Worlds Upon The Wind Demo
demos.shortDescription: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

demos.name: Hop Hop! Donut
demos.shortDescription: Strap on balloons and soar through the skies as Donut the corgi in this adorable 2D platformer! Battle evil cats, dodge deadly obstacles, and rescue your kidnapped owner in a whimsical adventure inspired by Balloon Fight.

demos.name: Nocturne for Cyl-Hestia
demos.shortDescription: Play as a memorialist and investigate a dystopian city in this 3D adventure game. Collect memories, unlock visions, hack encrypted data, and expose the truth in the face of a regime that manipulates memory.

demos.name: Beat Vector Demo
demos.shortDescription: A 360° Rhythm Game where smashing beats makes the world explode with effects. Transform every track into a massive light show!

demos.name: Birdwatching Notebook
demos.shortDescription: Turn your balcony into your very own birdwatching spot, and await the arrival of new avian friends! Enjoy a cozy idle game — place a tiny postcard on the corner of your screen, keeping you company with pleasant scenes and visiting birds. Oh, and don't forget your camera!

demos.name: Rose and Locket
demos.shortDescription: To save her daughter's soul, outlaw gunslinger Rose must journey into the Underwest - the wild west's mysterious underworld - and hunt the Deadly Sins. Experience this action-adventure platformer that blurs the line between graphic novel and game experience.

demos.name: Time of the Lilies
demos.shortDescription: A spy thriller featuring an escaped State Security agent navigating a conspiracy involving federal police, foreign agitators, and a familiar face from years past.

demos.name: Mexican Train Demo
demos.shortDescription: Mexican Train brings the classic game of Mexican Train Dominoes to 3D, supporting up to 7 players per online multiplayer session, or play solo and compete against up to 6 CPU players.

demos.name: Planet No More Demo
demos.shortDescription: Planet No More is an arcade-incremental game where you build a fleet to dynamically shatter celestials. With every weapon and fleet upgrade, you'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

demos.name: 7 Days Before the End
demos.shortDescription: 一个普通的早晨，五个大学生踏入同一间教室，却在陌生的空间醒来。纸条上写着： “在七天内找到真相，否则这里就会崩塌。”——你将如何度过这七天？

demos.name: Mystery Phantoms: Ghostly Secrets Collector's Edition
demos.shortDescription: Investigate haunted locations, find hidden objects, solve eerie puzzles, and uncover ghostly secrets as reality begins to crack around you.

demos.name: Super Sub: World Cup Demo
demos.shortDescription: Win the world cup through clever clicks, useful upgrades, silly own goals, and bending the rules. An active twist on incremental games that strips football down to just its beautiful beating heart: kick balls hard, score goals, earn money.

demos.name: Kanji Cats
demos.shortDescription: Tired of Anki or Duolingo? Always get confused by look-alike kanji or mix up on/kun readings? Kanji Cats is an edutainment game that teaches Japanese through cat-and-sushi-themed mini-games. Match, type, and sort kanji while learning in a cozy pixel-art sushi bar with cats!

demos.name: Deep Corp
demos.shortDescription: Dig mines, extract resources, and produce goods to restore order to the state. Become a successful businessman and an effective state governor in the late Wild West era!

demos.name: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
demos.shortDescription: Battle hordes of monsters, acquire new skills, and upgrade your abilities. Customize your build with hundreds of item combinations and reach the top to fulfill your deepest desires. Conquer the tower in this thrilling roguelite hack and slash survivors game!

demos.name: Apoikia Demo
demos.shortDescription: Apoikia is a city-building and economic simulation where you grow a settlement into a thriving hub by mastering supply chains, regional markets, and legal policy, with upcoming combat and free-market investment systems.

demos.name: Roommate Lover: Love in Progress
demos.shortDescription: With a mature and sophisticated female CEO, a stunningly beautiful news anchor, a college sweetheart, and the girl next door all entering her life, what will be the final outcome of this battle for love?

demos.name: Teamfight Manager 2
demos.shortDescription: Teamfight Manager is back with more detailed tactics, management, and a new MOBA-style gameplay. Take charge of a virtual e-sports team, build the ultimate roster, and become the greatest manager!

demos.name: TORR Demo
demos.shortDescription: A retro turn-based exploration game reminiscent of 80s RPGS! Explore the land of TORR by fighting daemons, solving puzzles, and uncovering the origins of the cloud sea that separates the world from the land below...

demos.name: DYLIA Demo
demos.shortDescription: DYLIA is a 2D adventure game with a strong emphasis on exploration and narrative. This is a journey of a mysterious girl and a mysterious duck. As the game progresses, you will learn their true identities and the truth of the world.

demos.name: Wild Horse Racing
demos.shortDescription: Wild Horse Racing is a fast-paced arcade horse racing game where timing is everything! Master the rhythm-based controls, leap over big jumps, and race through hand-crafted tracks around the world. Climb the leagues, manage your horse, and gallop from bronze to gold!

demos.name: EMUUROM
demos.shortDescription: A creature-scanning metroidvania. Explore an ancient paradise before it's lost forever. Study the EMUUROM creatures, document your findings in the EMUUDEX, and use what you learn to unlock new paths.

demos.name: Enter the Chronosphere
demos.shortDescription: Everything moves when you do in Enter the Chronosphere, the turn-based bullet hell roguelike. Each chronosphere is procedurally generated with defenders and biomes from the worlds it has consumed. Break in, find exotic weaponry and gadgets, outsmart hostile aliens, and fight your way to the core.

demos.name: One More Try: Prologue
demos.shortDescription: Fight your way through the lands of the magical kingdom in this turn-based, roguelike deck builder game. Fight your enemies by combining powerful poker combinations, enhance their effects, endow them with new properties, find magical relics and choose new classes for your hero.

demos.name: Crawl To The Depths Demo
demos.shortDescription: Crawl to the Depths is a first-person roguelite where you adventure through destructible caverns.

demos.name: Paralives
demos.shortDescription: Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?

demos.name: Rogue Quest
demos.shortDescription: Play poker hands to deal damage. A Pair chips, a Flush crushes, a Royal Flush ends fights. Build a deck across 5 classes, stack 88 power cards, and ascend a cursed spire where every run reshuffles the odds.

demos.name: Budgie's Bug Shop
demos.shortDescription: A short incremental game about catching bugs and running a shop filled with parakeets. Upgrade equipment, purchase game-breaking abilities, and maximize the profits of your Budgie-powered empire!

demos.name: AI Agent Lover
demos.shortDescription: A terminal-style desktop game where you approve or deny AI agent proposals with ok/deny. Work through roughly 200 dev dilemmas—Git, DB, infra, and more—under a 7-second clock, chasing score and streak combos.

demos.name: Bird Game 3
demos.shortDescription: Bird Game 3 is a fun multiplayer game for 2-8 players. Dive in with your friends as ravens or eagles, battle for eggs and customize your bird!

demos.name: TooneQuest Demo
demos.shortDescription: This Demo is an all-new level of main game TooneQuest!TooneQuest is a Creature Collection game. You must explore the islands and discover the whereabouts of the Toones, fun cartoon characters bouncing, leaping and waiting for you all around the world. Once found, you must capture them by succeeding in a test of skill and timing.

demos.name: OneDay:Eastern Gardens and Wilds(Lofi)
demos.shortDescription: "One Day" is an efficiency and focus tool designed to help you quickly enter a state of flow.Upgraded to-do list, diary, Pomodoro timer, beautiful music—experience ultimate efficiency! Drawing inspiration from ancient China, wander between traditional gardens and the rustic charm of the mountains.

demos.name: Dungeon Settlers Demo
demos.shortDescription: A colony sim based dungeon crawler where you manage your expedition to build a settlement in barren land, provide food and shelter for your people, lead them deep into the merciless dungeon, overcome challenging combat by your strategy.

demos.name: BRICKFALL

demos.name: Virtual Driving School

demos.name: LogiGolf Demo

Spend Intuition. 6–8 hours.

demos.name: Axiom Of Echoes: Proof Refactor Demo
Null Zone: No Way Back

demos.name: Blind Box Shop Simulator
demos.shortDescription: Open your own blind box store in the anime city of Akihabara. Stock the shelves with the latest blind boxes, or unbox them to collect rare hidden editions. Create a trendy blind box shop that attracts customers and expands your business.

demos.name: Drop and Grow

demos.name: SlimeVR

demos.name: Mouseward Demo
demos.shortDescription: Play the opening of Mouseward and get introduced to the world of Terrene. Take up your sword and uncover the secrets of a cursed kingdom in this soulslike collectathon. demos.name: The Guardian of Nature
demos.shortDescription: «The Guardian of Nature» is a hand-drawn, size-changing adventure. Embark on a magical journey with botanist Henry, use your size-changing ability to explore nature in big and small and solve solarpunk puzzles to put nature back in order.

demos.name: Cutout Village Demo
demos.shortDescription: Enjoy the calm of village life and spark your creativity in this building and crafting game inspired by cutout books.

demos.name: Paklyx
demos.shortDescription: PAKLYX is a turn-based puzzle game about finding the correct sequence of moves. Use special buttons to manipulate timers, delay them, and collect all keys in the level.

demos.name: Battle Nap Demo

Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

demos.name: BBS (Bulletin Board System) Magica
demos.shortDescription: Magical Girl Programming ✖︎ auto-battle! An office worker is assigned to manage a fan exchange bulletin board when she was once a magical girl, Become a magical girl in cyberspace and protect the message board.

demos.name: The Recipe for Life. A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses Demo
demos.shortDescription: You are a wanderer with a cracked soul and a home on wheels. Your task is to hear the voices of those who want to take their own lives, and to find the right words before they fall silent forever.

demos.name: Coffee Talk Tokyo

Violet Mansion

A story of friendship, and the courage to stay until the final whistle.

demos.name: PeeWee Purpdrank's FOENEM Clicker

demos.name: Bloodweight

demos.name: Pain Pain Go Away!

demos.shortDescription: One hand. Four arrow keys. Your weapon auto-fires while you dodge, climb, and swap elements to survive. 5 pilots, 75 skins, 35+ relics, 10 trials. A tiny roguelike shooter built around a beautiful bad idea.

demos.name: Flat 207
demos.shortDescription: A surrealist exploration of the mind of a man trapped in a room. Part game, part short film, part disaster, Flat 207 is a cursed video game with no traditional game mechanics that takes roughly 40 minutes to finish.

demos.name: Dissolution of the Silent Union Demo
Witch Pachi Demo
demos.shortDescription: Aim, shoot, and gather mana! Witch Pachi is a unique hybrid of physics-based pinball action and turn-based roguelike strategy. Build your deck of powerful spells, form mystical pacts, and master the board to defeat your enemies in this magical adventure.

demos.name: Breath Bound
demos.shortDescription: Breath Bound is a 2D co-op puzzle adventure where two divers share one oxygen tank and have to keep each other alive by scrounging air and navigating the treacherous obstacles of the sea. Every stretch of the journey back to the surface is a small test of coordination, timing and teamwork.

demos.name: Forgotten Records
demos.shortDescription: What would you do if you were stuck in an ancient shrine filled with creatures unknown to reality? Forgotten Records is a romance visual novel set in the modern world, where the protagonist wanders into the wrong shrine at the wrong time and has to escape.

demos.name: Uncle Lee’s Cookbook: Five Recipes for Disaster
demos.shortDescription: Uncle Lee has done it again. It’s up to you to pick up the pieces. Join rebellious teen Ines as she deals with the fallout of her uncle Lee’s experiments/inventions/cooking, in a modern point & click adventure in five self-contained episodes.

demos.name: Shadow Solitaire
demos.shortDescription: Shadow Solitaire is a roguelite, turn-based score-chasing card strategy game where you chain plays across multiple lanes, build powerful skill synergies, and manage risk through shop upgrades, casino bets, bank loans, and market trading.

demos.name: Minute Mark
demos.shortDescription: Minute Mark is a 2D singleplayer platformer where you run, jump, and slide across hand-drawn levels at incredible speed, racing against a strict timer. Rewind your mistakes and make creative skips to chase the leaderboard.

demos.name: Elfie: A Sand Plan
demos.shortDescription: Elfie: A Sand Plan is a relaxing and intuitive puzzle game where you help a small ambitious elephant build some sand castles. Enjoy spending time at the beach with your new rotund friend!

demos.name: The Serpent & The Seed Demo
demos.shortDescription: Explore the Garden of Eden in Act I of a sweeping poetic adventure retelling the greatest story in history through stunning art, immersive music, and atmospheric puzzles.

demos.name: Tennis Manager 26
demos.shortDescription: Step into the most advanced tennis management experience ever. Run your academy, develop top talent, upgrade your staff and facilities, and dominate the junior and pro circuits. A new chapter begins, are you ready to take control?

demos.name: PROMulti-TableTournament
demos.shortDescription: PROMulti-TableTournament is a Texas Hold’em multi-table tournament strategy simulator. read hands by position, stack depth, blinds, and opponent actions, then choose fold, call, raise, or all-in to practice MTT pacing. GTOrange judgment, stack control, and final table decisions.

demos.name: Battle Match: Samurai Wars
demos.shortDescription: Command thousands of individually-simulated samurai in tactical real-time battles. Free sandbox mode. Online multiplayer.

demos.name: Port Trader
demos.shortDescription: Incremental game about trading goods between ports. Buy and sell to earn profit. Upgrade ships, increase port capacity, optimize production rate, hire new captains, automate your trading and grow your merchant empire.

demos.name: Duriano
demos.shortDescription: Duriano is a top-down arena roguelite game where the player will be a hero durian of the Norse wielding a weapon to fight upon a god of Norse mythology. From different weapons, Durian hero, God’s trail, items will lead the player to create a build and defeat the giant of fire.

demos.name: Chill & Reel
demos.shortDescription: A cozy idle fishing game where you play as an adorable alligator angler. Designed to run in the corner of your screen, it's the perfect companion for work or study—featuring rich animations that make every moment feel like watching a charming short film.

demos.name: Hamster Ballers Demo
demos.shortDescription: A friendship-ending, physics-based, ragebait game where you play as hamsters trapped inside a hamster ball and you can't get out until you complete this stupid obstacle course.

demos.name: Necromancer's Army Demo
demos.shortDescription: A dark narrative idle game where your clicks fuel a ritual that begins to answer back. This free demo runs the full Act 1 arc plus a taste of Act 2. 30 to 60 minutes. Wishlist for the full five-act story and three endings.

demos.name: The Last Winter Knight
demos.shortDescription: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.

demos.name: Super Night Riders S1
demos.shortDescription: Super Night Riders S1 is a modern checkpoint arcade racer inspired by '80s classics. Race as Alice, the Red Rider, across 12 stages from day to sunrise. Dodge rivals and beat the clock - distance matters more than position.

demos.name: Greenhearth Necromancer
demos.shortDescription: Raise a garden... from the dead! Greenhearth Necromancer is a cozy, witchy, semi-idle game about caring for living and undead plants alike. Grow cute plants in your balcony garden, cast spells, and brew potions, enjoying the chill idle gameplay and ambience throughout your day.

demos.name: Drifting Dots
demos.shortDescription: A minimalist physics roguelite where you create a mesmerizing cascade of droplets. Choose from three distinct modes and discover powerful upgrade synergies to master the flow. Calm, complex, and endlessly replayable.

demos.name: Project Looking Glass Demo
demos.shortDescription: 1963. A classified CIA experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

demos.name: argmax Loop
demos.shortDescription: die listening to techno bangers.

demos.name: NOOK FALL: West Town
demos.shortDescription: A charming yet fantastical town, where vitality and decay constantly collide. We hope that through interactions with characters and objects, and the sensory experience created by visuals and sound, you can connect with the emotions and charm of this little world of West Town.

demos.name: Cliff Kingdom Demo
demos.shortDescription: The lighthouse has gone dark! You awake as Mothboy, last in a long line of lightkeepers summoned when something goes wrong. In this action packed adventure you climb, fight and explore the depths of Cliff Kingdom searching for the lost light.

demos.name: Descension
demos.shortDescription: Descend into the Alternate Realm to save your lost friend and face The Ultimate Entity. Customize your party, master unique Soul Shards, and grow stronger—physically, mentally, and emotionally—in this stat-driven sandbox RPG.

demos.name: The Siege of Jeomdo
demos.shortDescription: Hope flickers against impossible odds. In this narrative RPG, step into the shoes of a retired soldier, thrust into a desperate last stand to save Jeomdo Village. With supplies dwindling and time running out, your decisions will shape the fate of those who look to you for salvation.

demos.name: Retro Manager
demos.shortDescription: A fast-paced retro football management game inspired by the 90s. Build your squad, tweak tactics, and watch matches unfold minute-by-minute.

demos.name: Order of the Ivy
demos.shortDescription: A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest. Set in a dystopian America, the party must overthrow evil feudal lords called the Quorum while managing Kyle's worst impulses.

demos.name: S-mail
demos.shortDescription: After the death of your lover May, you suddenly receive a new email: she is back, in the form of AI "M". The lover who "lives" in the mailbox, who is strong and eternal, always online, and always loves you. You just need to send letters to her: your choices will affect her and the story.

demos.name: Wordban: a text-based Sokoban game
demos.shortDescription: Wordban is a word-based sokoban game, where a special transformation block defines the cornerstone of how all things operate. Control "Wordo" to push blocks, change the rules of the level, and read Wordo's diary!

demos.name: Lenos
demos.shortDescription: Loot, shoot, and survive the depths with friends. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, gear up with powerful weapons and perks, and fight your way to extraction in this top-down co-op dungeon crawler.

demos.name: Rollick N' Roll
demos.shortDescription: Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Explore a collection of marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist.
